name: Ground-Based Phaser-2
_comment: R1.14, Advanced Missions SSD book page 13. One of the ground base fits — the chassis is the
GBD1's and is identical across all of them: one shield of 12 (P2.73), two hull boxes, a bridge,
sensor 6|0, scanner 0|9, dam-con 4|2|0, five crew, two boarding parties, minCrew 2, DK:4, EX:0,
CR:0. Only the weapons, the power plant, the BPV and the year differ.
The cheapest fit at 7 points. 'Bases and defense satellites of these types were not
used by the Romulans prior to Y161' — a scenario restriction, not a hull property.
